notes.title: Prepare for the Beatdown! KIBORG Release Date Revealed + New Trailer!
notes.content:
Hey Brawlers!
We're beyond thrilled to finally announce the official release date for Kiborg! Mark your calendars for April 30! Get ready to dive into the chaotic world of The Last Ticket Show and unleash your inner fighter.
To celebrate this momentous occasion, we've also dropped a brand-new release date trailer! Get a glimpse of the brutal challenges that await you.

Watch the Release Date Trailer Here: [previewyoutube=Yk-nwn4YLYA;full][/previewyoutube]

Morgan Lee has been accused of war crimes he didn’t commit and sentenced to a 1,300-year sentence on the galaxy’s worst prison planet with no hope of parole. Death provides no escape, as his jailors will keep reviving him until he serves every last second. But one way out does exist: win on Cable Galactica’s hottest game show, “The Last Ticket".

In Kiborg, you'll:
[list]
[*] Fight your way through procedurally generated arenas: No two runs are ever the same!
[*] Try a variety of unique implants: Each with their own fighting enhancement and abilities.
[*] Unleash devastating combos and special abilities: Dominate your foes with style.
[*] Collect powerful items and upgrades: Adapt your build to survive the onslaught.
[*] Face challenging enemies: Test your skills against formidable foes.
[*] And much more!
[/list]

We've poured our hearts and souls into creating a roguelike beat-'em-up that delivers intense action, replayability, and a whole lot of fun. We can't wait for you to experience it!

[b]Don't forget to wishlist Kiborg on Steam to stay updated and be notified the moment it launches![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2405060

Thank you for your incredible support throughout development. We're counting down the days until you can join the fight!
See you in the coming season of “The Last Ticket”!

notes.title: ESDigital Games Reveals Exciting Gamescom Line-up!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to reveal our [b]2024 Gamescom lineup[/b], with some stellar titles showcasing never-before-seen gameplay in both the Business and Consumer halls at this year’s event!

[previewyoutube=LlQ6vq4RCJ4;full][/previewyoutube]

Gamers heading to [b]Gamescom[/b] will have the chance to get hands-on with some truly exciting titles covering all kinds of genres! Located in the bustling [b]Indie Arena Booth (Hall 10.2, Booth F010g - E019)[/b] we will be showcasing brand new game demos for [b]AWAKEN - Astral Blade, Steel Seed, Island of Winds, BattleJuice Alchemist and Sky of Tides[/b].

There will also be the chance to snap a picture with two awesome cosplayers portraying the protagonists [b]Tania from AWAKEN - Astral Blade[/b] and [b]Zoe from Steel Seed[/b] as well as grabbing some cool branded merchandise after trying out the hands-on demos.

In addition to the Indie Arena Booth, our team will also have playable demos for [b]Cats on Duty, Memory Lost, and REMEDIUM[/b] on the [b]Polish Indie Booth (Hall 10.2, F-041)[/b] for fans to try out! 

[h3]More information on the great games available to play at Gamescom:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/458430/Steel_Seed/

[b]Steel Seed (Storm in Teacup Studio)[/b] is a single player stealth-action adventure game set in a dark sci-fi world. In her epic journey inside a hostile underground facility run by AIs, Zoe is alone with Koby, a flying drone, as her only companion. Use Zoe's parkour skills to traverse the underground facility and gain a tactical advantage. Don't forget about stealth-based techniques to explore the facility's hostile environment undetected by robotic entities and guards. Some confrontations can be avoided through efficient movement. Also, get acquainted with KOBY, because he is the master key of Steel Seed and Zoe's guide on her lonely and dangerous journey inside the underground facility. By working together, they create a formidable duo and bring something new to every fight.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689340/Island_of_Winds/

[b]Island of Winds (Parity Games Studio)[/b] is an adventure game set in a fantastical world inspired by 17th century Iceland and its folklore. Experience the story of Brynhildur, a Balance Keeper who embarks on a journey of self-discovery. Core gameplay involves intriguing puzzles, spellcasting, and a focus on empathy encounters. The core gameplay involves spellcasting, intriguing puzzles, fantastical lore, and a special focus on approaching encounters with empathy. Island of Winds features a semi-open world environment that explores themes of self-doubt, violence, regret and empathy, as well as the conservation of nature.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1716310/AWAKEN__Astral_Blade/

[b]AWAKEN - Astral Blade (Dark Pigeon Games)[/b]. Weave your own story in this dark fairy tale 2D action-platformer metroidvania. In the mysterious ancient ruins, you will adventure with Tania to reveal her origins and fate. Is there any chance of survival in the darkest and desperate place? Slain your foes with a wide range of combos: from fastest to slowest. Parry enemy attacks to gain an advantage, use Fast Stand Up ability to get back into the fight and dash into enemies while they're attacking to slow the world around you and gain damage immunity. Combos and Skills will also help you to break through hordes of enemies and defeat bosses. Control the course of the story, help Tania make choices at the crucial moments of the game and take your own path to reveal mysteries of the past and present. Different routes may lead you to different endings. Search the Horace Islands for clues and information about mysterious and dangerous world of the AWAKEN - Astral Blade.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120330/Sky_of_Tides/

[b]Sky of Tides (Lofty Sky Entertainment Studio)[/b] is a sci-fi narrative game set in a technologically advanced universe on the brink of war. Play as Rin, who must search for her missing father and heal the broken planet of Numen. Explore the world while your choices shape your character.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1384060/BattleJuice_Alchemist/

[b]BattleJuice Alchemist (Alchemical Works Studio)[/b] is a complex alchemy RPG that adds a unique item and skill system to the classic aRPG formula. Focus on isometric combat or opt for JRPG-style one-on-one fights. Explore the wilderness, learn ritual magic, build a tower and craft potions to fight the demonic hordes of Samhain. Juice, the alchemist, is called to Caribou Creek to fight the demons that roam the lands. As your unique version of Juice you explore the wilderness that once was New England. Fight evil in classic action RPG isometric top down view and in bullet-time close combat. Find and craft items with game-changing powers. Master BattleJuice Alchemist's deck-building mechanics by arranging your compilation of flasks to suit your playstyle. Accentuate your character beyond character customization by using ritual magic as long-term buffs. Meet strange creatures from the Crossroads while the dark plot of BattleJuice Alchemist unravels.

[h3]Additionally, there are opportunities for hands-on with these titles:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1659090/REMEDIUM/

[b]REMEDIUM[/b] is a fast-paced twin-stick shooter set in a grim post-apocalyptic Renaissance setting. A special build for journalists, with all acts available + some never before seen new acts.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2447260/Cats_on_Duty/

[b]Cats on Duty[/b] is a purr-fect blend of match-3 and real time strategy with tower defense mechanics. The full build of the Deluxe Edition will be available.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483190/Memory_Lost/

[b]Memory Lost[/b] is a story-driven cyberpunk twin-stick action shooter where players will have to capture the minds and bodies of their enemies to survive during combat.

Plus, if you feel like talking to the devs, we have good news for you! You can meet the lead developers from "[b]Storm in TeaCup[/b]", "[b]Parity Games[/b]", "[b]Lofty Sky Entertainment[/b]", "[b]Sobaka Studio[/b]" and "[b]Alchemical Works[/b]" at our booths at Gamescom!

Our team is looking forward to welcoming all gamers to the [b]Indie Arena Booth from 21-25 August[/b], so head over to [b]Hall 10.2[/b], say hi and play some awesome games!

notes.title: REMEDIUM Act 2 - New Content Released Today!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the release of [b]the first content update of Act 2 for REMEDIUM[/b]!

Today’s content update is the first stage in the full Act 2 release, including a new location, new mutant types, boss and new story content being made available for players to experience. A further two locations, enemy types, bosses and additional story arcs will be released over the coming weeks to complete the full Act 2 launch.

[previewyoutube=bm1crfsWnqM;full][/previewyoutube]

We also pleased to announce that [b]there will be NO price increase for REMEDIUM following today’s content update[/b]. The price will only increase when we are happy with the content and quality of the game in general and Act 2 in particular. For now, the focus is delivering the most polished and content-complete version of the game during its Steam Early Access phase.  

Since the launch of Act 1, we’ve been busy gathering your feedback and introducing many quality-of-life improvements and new features, many of which were requested by players already active on the Steam Early Access release. Some of these quality-of-life improvements include the balancing of battles to make weak enemies more dynamic, a reworked dash movement, new enemy spawn mechanics, improved VFX, blood effects and HUD, as well as many other cosmetic enhancements to the game world. We will continue to work with the community on today’s update to improve and polish the upcoming content ahead of the full Act 2 release and extend our thanks for the support and feedback on REMEDIUM’s Early Access launch so far and look forward to further collaboration throughout the development journey.

Following directly on from the devastating boss battle at the end of Act 1, REMEDIUM Act 2 opens a new chapter in the hunt for a cure to the Grey plague and to your very survival in the world ravaged by hordes of mutants and chimeras. Armed only with your journal, you must navigate the snowy mountain paths and survive the onslaught of warring tribes of mutants spread across three village locations. In each new location, the blood thirsty mutants are protected by a terrifying and unique boss, which must be defeated in order to unveil the path to the cure for the disease and the survival of the remaining humans. 

[h3]REMEDIUM Act 2 features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Act 2 will introduce three new locations with unique mutant types and terrifying bosses.
[*] Today’s update unveils the new Fort location along with new mutants and boss type - Despite their beast-like looks these mutants wear armor and use human weapons like clubs, spears and even mortars. They inhabit a ruined fortress nestled into the mountainside protected by a deadly new boss. Mutant types: Grunt, Pikeman, Gunner. Boss: Huntress. Two more locations (Mine and Abbey), mutant types and bosses, will complete Act 2 and be released soon.
[*] Continuation of the intriguing storyline of the hero’s deadly journey.  
[*] Players can craft new parts for their weapons (to further customize them and deal different types of damage) with the new reagents found in Act 2.
[*] Updated visuals and player accessibility for an enhanced gameplay experience.
[*] An improved upgrade system where players can now spend resources to become stronger. 
[*] Dash movement and Almalgams use have been split for greater accessibility.
[*] Language support for English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Polish, Chinese, Japanese and Korean, with further enhancements to be added. [/list]

notes.title: BattleJuice Alchemist transmutes into action!
notes.content:
[i]ESDigital Games[/i] and [i]Alchemical Works[/i] are delighted to reveal their action adventure RPG title [b]BattleJuice Alchemist[/b] and its new announcement trailer!

[previewyoutube=_JlygN27g1Q;full][/previewyoutube]

BattleJuice Alchemist is a complex alchemy RPG that adds an equipment-based skill system to the classic aRPG formula. Focus on top-down combat or opt for JRPG-style one-on-one fights. Explore the wilderness, learn ritual magic, and craft potions to fight demonic hordes overrunning the lands.

Juice, the alchemist, is called to Caribou Creek to fight the demons that roam the lands. As your unique version of Juice, you explore the wilderness that once was New England. Fight evil in classic action RPG isometric top-down view and in bullet-time close combat.

Find and craft items with game-changing powers. Master BattleJuice Alchemist’s deck-building mechanics by arranging your compilation of flasks to suit your playstyle. Accentuate your character beyond character customization by using ritual magic as long-term buffs. Meet strange creatures from the Crossroads while the dark plot of BattleJuice Alchemist unravels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38469214/3a29e0c41079d009f23b3a23afabdb7c86aa9d70.jpg[/img]

[h3]UNIQUE ITEMS AND CHARACTER BUILDS[/h3]
[b]Loot and Craft[/b]: As an alchemist you wear no armor and wield no sword, but you rain down fire on your enemies. Find flasks with unique properties in the wilderness or craft them at your workbench. In deck-building fashion you create a compilation of flasks which you randomly draw from.

[b]Unique Skill System[/b]: In BattleJuice Alchemist, your flasks are your skills. Every flask can be used the normal way and at times in a supercharged, "jucified" way for stronger effects. Some flasks have powers attached to them that drastically change their effects when used, which allows you to develop your own playstyle.

[h3]EXPLORE A DARK WORLD[/h3]
[b]Procedural Landscapes, Hand-crafted Towns[/b]: The world of BattleJuice Alchemist is separated into vast levels of procedural landscape. Every valley, sea, river, mountain, building, stone, tree and item is placed by a unique algorithm. This allows you to continue exploring after you completed the main story. Quest locations are still hand-crafted to tell compelling stories.

[b]Dark Lands to Discover[/b]: You are influenced by daytime and weather effects and so are your enemies. But they are also buffed by the evermore spawning demons’ presence. Find dark altars to hold their influence at bay and discover many other secrets.

[h3]ENGAGING COMBAT[/h3]
[b]Classic isometric ARPG action[/b]: Fight your enemies from afar in classic top down view. Throw explosive or freezing flasks at them, prepare ambushes of explosive barrels. Use the “Frog Hop” flask to jump away from danger or right into close combat.

[b]Close Combat with Bullet-time[/b]: Enter close combat with an enemy, where you can interact hands on by dodging or using smoke flasks to avoid being hit. Manage your resources and flasks during these intense one on one battles against your awe-inspiring enemies from the Crossroads.
